comment: Read from the maker's source at 2.6.1, commit e6a0c67. The menu wording is read verbatim from DitDitWidget::appendContextMenu. The threshold on all three inputs is 1V, which is higher than the 0.5V every other Moffenzeef module uses. The display carries the prompt DOUBLE-CLICK TO TYPE when empty, and the module prints NO TEXT INPUT and NO CLOCK INPUT on it when either is missing. The text field is part of one display widget, so there is no separate control for it to click. The 1V threshold on all three inputs is the highest in the plugin bar one: the record and play jacks on Tehom, the two mode jacks on INTENSIFIES, the Particles on/off jack and the Tantz clock also read 1V, and the Runner's chorus jack reads 2.5V, while the rest of the plugin reads 0.5V.
